thread:
Jon (AE): Heads up — BetaCorp procurement said they must pay Redwood directly (desktop PO + AP invoice) and cannot use AWS billing. Theyre asking for a 12-month committed ARR with a 30% off list. Can we support seller-invoiced private offer and still list on Marketplace?

Priya (Sales Ops): We can do a seller-invoiced private offer so they get an invoice from us, but marketplace listing still exists for entitlements. Important: seller-invoiced private offers require us to handle invoicing, collections, and remit to AWS per their terms. Also need to confirm minimum deal size for AWS to approve private offers.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): Technical note: if they sign a private-offer SKU, usage will still be tracked by the marketplace SKU. We can attach a quota/commit in the PO. For the POC they want volume-based billing w/ monthly reconciliation. Recommend a short metered POC and a spend cap enforced by us.

Elena (Finance): 30% off is outside our standard band. Discounts >25% need Deal Desk + VP signoff. Also: seller-invoiced deals add settlement lag and we need their TAX ID, billing address, and PO template before we can invoice. If they ask for net45 vs net30 that's a separate credit review.

Amir (Legal): Two legal items: (1) private-offer + seller invoice = we need an MSA that references marketplace usage terms where applicable; (2) BetaCorp wants a clause to pass through AWS marketplace refunds to them. We generally don't accept unlimited pass-throughs. Custom clauses slow approval.

Jon (AE): BetaCorp says their AP system requires an EDI-compatible invoice and specific fields (contract number, cost center). Can we generate EDI-friendly invoices?

Elena (Finance): We don't natively emit EDI. We can include required fields on our PDF invoices and add metadata in the invoice XML if our PSP supports it, but full EDI integration is a longer project. For now we can provide enhanced invoices and a CSV export for AP.

Priya (Sales Ops): DealDeskBot — what's the approval chain and any marketplace minimums here?

DealDeskBot: Discounts >25% require VP Sales + Revenue Ops approval. Seller-invoiced private offers >$100k ARR need Finance pre-approval. AWS may require a minimum annual contract value for private offers; confirm with AWS rep. Ensure credit checks performed for net terms.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): For the POC: propose 2-week metered test with a hard spend cap of $5k and a usage profile doc. I can push a demo instance and token cap. Also will provide a simple script to capture token counts so billing matches expectations.

Jon (AE): They also asked whether we can pass marketplace discount codes on top of the private-offer price. Procurement expects the discount to appear on the invoice line item.

Amir (Legal): Invoices can show the negotiated price, but we can't apply AWS promotional coupons to seller-invoiced private offers. Any discount must be billed by the seller and documented in the SOW/MSA.

Elena (Finance): Action items for billing path: (1) collect legal name + TAX ID + billing addr, (2) PO template from BetaCorp, (3) AP contact + email for invoice delivery, (4) confirm payment terms (net30/net45/card), (5) credit check. I'll start intake.

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll open a private-offer request with our AWS rep and flag potential minimums. Also will start deal desk packet for the 30% request.

DealDeskBot: Checklist: [SalesOps open AWS private-offer ticket], [Finance run credit + EDI feasibility], [Legal draft MSA addendum for invoice passthrough], [Solutions Eng prepare POC scope & spend cap], [VP Sales approval for >25% discount].

Jon (AE): I'll ask BetaCorp to confirm whether they can accept seller invoices (they said no AWS billing), and get their PO template + EDI fields. Will update thread. Thanks. :pray:

Priya (Sales Ops): Looping in VP Sales for discount pre-approval now.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): Ill push the POC plan by EOD with a tiny runbook that enforces the $5k hard cap.

Elena (Finance): If they insist on card capture via our PSP we need PCI readiness. Flagging as high friction.

Amir (Legal): I'll prepare a short MSA addendum we can reuse for seller-invoiced marketplace private offers to speed future deals.

Jon (AE): Perfect. Will post BetaCorp documents once I get them.
